title: Wellness Membership Charges and Session Credits on the Member Account
content:
Five kinds of charge appear on a Wellness Membership account: monthly dues, the enrollment fee, the freeze fee, the late fee and the early-termination fee.

## Billing day and commitment end date

- Dues are drafted on the member's billing day, which is one of the billing days the tier offers.
- The commitment end date is the number of billing periods of the tier's commitment after the start date; a tier whose commitment is 0 has no commitment end date.

## Charges

| Charge | When it is billed | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Monthly dues | on the billing day, for every billing period the membership is active, past due or pending cancellation; no dues are billed for frozen days | the monthly dues of the membership |
| Enrollment fee | at sign-up, unless waived under the enrollment fee waivers | the enrollment fee of the tier |
| Freeze fee, non-medical freeze | per month, or part of a month, frozen | the freeze fee of the tier for each such month |
| Freeze fee, medical freeze | nothing is billed where the tier waives the freeze fee for a medical freeze | none |
| Late fee | once, for a billing period that becomes past due | the late fee of the tier |
| Early-termination fee | when a cancellation takes effect before the commitment end date, unless waived under the cancellation terms | the early-termination fee of the tier |

## Session credits

- Each monthly dues charge credits the tier's monthly allotment of maintenance sessions for that billing period.
- The tier's orientation sessions are credited at the start.

## Worked statement (hypothetical figures)

A member on a tier with monthly dues of 79.00 and a monthly allotment of 1 session:

- Each billing day while the membership is active: monthly dues of 79.00 billed, and 1 maintenance session credited for that period.
- A non-medical freeze running from the 1st of one month to the 15th of the next covers one whole month and part of a second month, so two months of freeze fee are billed; at a freeze fee of 10.00 that is 10.00 multiplied by 2, which is 20.00.
- A medical freeze on a tier that waives the fee for it bills no freeze fee.
- If a billing period becomes past due, a late fee is billed once for that period.

## Questions this statement answers

**Are dues billed while the membership is pending cancellation?** Yes; monthly dues are billed for every billing period the membership is pending cancellation.

**Are dues billed for frozen days?** No.

**Is the late fee billed more than once for the same period?** No; once for a period that becomes past due.
